newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar falls as sugar quota release delayed.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar falls as sugar quota release delayed.

text.p: Indian sugar prices on Wednesday fell as the additional sugar free sale quota for this month was yet to be released by the government after last week's announcement, dealers said.
Demand resistance at higher levels capped the recent rally while improved arrivals dragged prices lower.
The government last week announced additional free sale quota of 50,000 tonnes for this month but so far no release of sugar has been made out of the additional quota, one broker said.
"From today the government has commenced release of sugar from additional quota which in turn improved arrivals in the Bombay market," he said.

In ready delivery sugar S-30 slid by five rupees at 1,410/1,440 rupees per quintal while M-30 moved down by 10/20 rupees at 1,445/1,485 rupees per quintal. Sugar mill delivery also fell to 1,350/1,370 rupees per quintal from 1,360/1,375 rupees per quintal.
